FAQs

Common Questions

Who is eligible for the Proud Responsible Taxpayer Badge?
Any individual or business who files their ITR through Mk FinServ Group is eligible. After successful filing and internal verification, you'll receive your personalised badge to generate and share.
Is the badge officially recognised by the Government of India?
No. The badge is a private recognition by Mk FinServ Group. It is not a government award or certification. It is a community initiative to celebrate compliance culture in India, operating under the Income Tax Act, 1961.
Can I use the badge on LinkedIn and business materials?
Yes! Members are granted a non-exclusive licence to display and share the badge on social media, LinkedIn profiles, email signatures, and business collateral for the duration of their active membership status.
How do I join the LinkedIn community group?
Visit our LinkedIn Group "Mk Financial Council – Tax, GST & Wealth Club (India)" using the link on this page and request to join. Our admin team will review and approve your request.
Is my PAN or financial data safe when using the badge generator?
Absolutely. The badge generator on this page works entirely in your browser — no name or data is uploaded to any server. All data submitted for ITR filing is processed under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) on India-based servers.
Compliance & Law

Terms & Legal Framework

Under the Digital Services and Consumer Protection Guidelines (India)

1. Recognition Nature

Mk Financial Council is a voluntary recognition program by Mk FinServ Group™. It does not confer any legal or statutory status and does not replace any government certification. This initiative operates within the Income Tax Act, 1961 and CGST Act, 2017, and is independent of any government department. In accordance with the Emblems and Names (Prevention of Improper Use) Act, 1950, we explicitly state we are not a government agency.

2. Data Privacy (DPDP Act, 2023)

Member data provided for verification (PAN, Aadhaar, ITR details) is processed under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Data is stored on Indian servers and used only for internal verification purposes. The badge generator works entirely in your browser — no data is transmitted.

3. Usage of Insignia & Badge

The Council Badge remains the intellectual property of Mk FinServ Group. Members are granted a non-exclusive licence to display the badge for marketing while their compliance status is active. Misuse or display after membership lapse leads to immediate revocation.

4. Disclaimer of Liability

Membership does not guarantee success in loan approvals, visa applications, or tenders. It is a record of past compliance. Mk FinServ Group is not liable for any third-party financial decisions based on a member's council status.

Mandatory Statutory Declaration

"The Mk Financial Council is a private professional recognition initiative. It is not an 'Institutional Body' under the Companies Act nor a 'Regulatory Authority' under SEBI/RBI/IRDAI. Membership signifies that the individual/entity has engaged our professional services for tax/financial discipline and has passed our internal benchmarks for consistency."

Transparent Verification

Starting Q3 2026, every member ID will be searchable on our public blockchain-backed registry for instant B2B trust validation.
